tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Nutreek!
tour.welcome.text: This short tour shows you the main features of the dashboard. You can close it at any time and restart it from "Guided tour" in the side menu.
tour.week.title: Week navigation
tour.week.text: Use the arrows to move between weeks. "Today" goes back to the current week.
tour.days.title: Days of the week
tour.days.text: Pick a day to see its meals, the macros summary and water, and to add foods.
tour.template.title: Apply a template
tour.template.text: If you have created a weekly template (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner…), you can apply it here to structure the week in one click.
tour.sections.title: Sections
tour.sections.text: From here you reach recipes, ingredients, nutrition plan, shopping list and statistics. "Appearance", to choose light or dark mode and color, is at the bottom of the menu (on a phone, under "More").
tour.flash.restarted: Tour restarted. Go back to the dashboard to begin.
